decisions.reason: As a core bread product very close to our traditional range and still shown after launch, it likely fits steady everyday demand and uses existing baking capabilities efficiently.

A sweet pastry matches our established confectionery business, requires no major new capabilities, and is the kind of incremental line extension a craft bakery would usually retain if it reached the website more than once.
This farmhouse bread is strongly aligned with our heritage positioning and regional craft image, though being newer than A and C makes its continuation slightly less certain.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen has its own page and a gold-award reference, so despite being seasonal it looks like a distinctive festive specialty worth continuing.

The premium Christmas stollen also carries a gold-award signal and suits our festive gift and specialty offer, although its premium positioning makes it a bit more exposed to assortment pruning than standard bakery lines.
